words.def: an important stage or event that shows progress in a project.
words.book: I am pleased to share that we have achieved the latest milestone.
uses: We've reached a key milestone: all 40 battery strings are installed and tested.
Payment will be linked to three milestones: delivery, installation and commissioning.
dont: We finished an important step in the project.

words.def: a short summary of what was already said or agreed.
words.book: As a brief recap, we discussed ___.
uses: As a brief recap, we agreed to replace the batteries at both sites in October.
can someone recap the call? i joined late
Let me quickly recap the action points before we finish.
dont: I will say again what we said in short.

words.def: to give official permission for something.
words.book: Could you please authorize ___ so that we can move forward with the project/task?
uses: Could you please authorize the purchase order so we can release the equipment?
who can authorize the discount? need it today
Only the finance manager can authorize payments over 100,000 EGP.
dont: Please give me the permission to buy.
doo: Could you please authorize the purchase?

words.ar: مطابق لـ / ملتزم بـ (قوانين أو معايير)
words.def: following a rule, law, standard or contract.
words.book: In order to proceed with ___, I need your authorization to ensure that we're in compliance with ___.
uses: All installations are carried out in compliance with IEC safety standards.
is the new site in compliance with the fire code?
We need to stay in compliance with the SLA terms.
dont: This is according with the rules.
doo: This is in compliance with the regulations.

words.def: the agreed rules about when and how a customer pays (e.g. 30 days, 50% advance).
words.book: Could we schedule a call to go over the pricing/payment terms in more detail?
uses: Our payment terms are 50% advance and 50% upon delivery.
can we give them 60-day payment terms? they're asking
The client accepted the price but wants to renegotiate the payment terms.
dont: The conditions of paying are 30 days.

words.def: to make a small official change to a contract, document or agreement.
words.book: Would it be possible to add/amend a specific clause or provision in the contract/agreement to better protect our interests?
uses: Please find attached the amended contract with the updated warranty period.
can u amend the quote? they want 3 years warranty
We'd like to amend clause 7 regarding response times.
dont: We want to change something in the contract.
doo: We'd like to amend the contract.

upgrade.plain: I send you the file in the attachment.
pro: I send you the file attached in the attachment.
Please find attached the quotation for your review.
The file is in the attach.
upgrade.why: ‎Please find attached‎ هي الجملة المعتادة في الإيميلات.

upgrade.plain: You remember we talked before about this?
upgrade.ar: فاكر إحنا اتكلمنا قبل كده في الموضوع ده؟
pro: As you may recall, we previously discussed this.
Do you remember what we said before or no?
upgrade.why: ‎As you may recall‎ أرقّ وأكثر احترافية من ‎You remember‎.

upgrade.plain: The project is going good and we will finish in time.
upgrade.ar: المشروع ماشي كويس وهنخلص في ميعادنا
pro: We're on track to meet the project's objectives.
Please reply at your earliest convenience.
upgrade.why: ‎at your earliest convenience‎ مؤدبة بس بتوصّل الاستعجال.

pro: There seems to have been a misunderstanding.
You are mistaken in understanding me.
upgrade.why: ماتلومش العميل؛ ‎There seems to have been‎ بتشيل اللوم.

upgrade.plain: Sorry, it's my mistake, I will fix it.
pro: Sorry, my mistake, I repair it.
It's not my fault but sorry.
I apologize for my mistake, and I am committed to making things right.
upgrade.why: ‎committed to making things right‎ بتبيّن مسؤولية واحترافية.
